name: insightops-vuddy2
description: Marketplace for the insightops-buddy plugin: autonomous end-to-end incident response for failed Databricks production job runs.

plugins.name: insightops-buddy
plugins.description: Autonomous, end-to-end incident response for a failed Databricks production job run -- diagnose (checking prior incident history both for this job and platform-wide by error category), ticket (full Kanban lifecycle, with two-way data lineage), fix, PR, review (with CI status surfaced at the merge gate), verify, alert (one threaded 5-stage Slack timeline, tagged with the job ID at every stage), publish a Confluence postmortem, and clean up its own isolated clone afterward, across 11 phases plus Confluence.
